description: Source code implementing message queue (mq) creation, push, pop, and destruction functions with thread safety, using POSIX APIs and custom data structures.

classes.name: _xr_mq_t
classes.description: Internal structure representing a message queue with synchronization primitives.

classes.name: _xr_mq_node_t
classes.description: Node in linked list of message queues.

classes.name: _xr_mq_list_t
classes.description: Linked list managing multiple message queues.

methods.name: xr_mq_create
methods.description: Creates a new message queue with specified attributes, allocates resources, and adds it to the global list.

methods.name: xr_mq_push
methods.description: Pushes a message into the specified message queue, signaling via eventfd.

methods.name: xr_mq_pop
methods.description: Retrieves a message from the specified message queue, handling synchronization and eventfd signaling.

methods.name: xr_mq_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a message queue, freeing resources and removing it from the global list.
